title: Epic Similes — What Is an Epic Simile? | Homeric Simile
skills: identify epic similes in literary texts
distinguish epic similes from ordinary similes
analyze how extended comparisons develop imagery and meaning
interpret figurative language in epic literature
alignment_note: Introduces epic, or Homeric, similes as extended comparisons commonly used in epic poetry. Supports figurative-language analysis, close reading, imagery interpretation, and the study of classical and epic literary traditions across high school English courses.
